info.name: craigslist Dark 2026
info.description: A comfortable dark theme for craigslist. Covers every city site, the search app with its filters and map, listings, postings, forums and account pages.

/* craigslist Dark
     craigslist ships no CSS custom properties: every colour is a literal,
     so each surface needs its own override and the bulk blocks below are
     keyed to the exact upstream literal they replace — keep that
     elevation order when adding a surface.
     `#bacff2` does double duty upstream as both hover and selected; on
     dark those split into a neutral hover (#262d36) and an accent fill
     (#1f4b7a), so a set filter no longer reads as a hover.
     `body.nightTheme` (the forums' own dark mode) is deliberately
     untouched — only `body.dayTheme` is themed. */

  :root {
    color-scheme: dark;
  }

  /* ---------- base ---------- */

  html,
  body {
    background-color: #14181d !important;
    color: #c4cdd6 !important;

  }

    border-color: #2d333b !important;

  /* Unimportant on purpose: it only has to beat the UA button face on
     controls the site never styles; any author rule still outranks it. */
  button,
  input[type="submit"],
